method: Deep-research historical replay from the already-frozen 2025Q1 event set. Company evidence and deterministic pre-cutoff regime snapshots are bounded by memo cutoff. No post-cutoff selected-stock outcomes are opened before lock.
caveats: Current model weights may encode later outcomes.
Pre-cutoff regime snapshots use only historical bars through each cutoff.
No post-cutoff selected-stock return is opened before memo lock.
Use as holdout process evidence, not clean forward alpha.
